Remedial action: Run a same-day absentees call-back. Mark the class register before the first period and report the 10 absentees by name to the office daily.

Scoring options: Below 70% = 0; 70% and above = 1; 80% and above = 2; 90% and above = 3
Remedial action: Hold a uniform check at the assembly line. Identify defaulters by roll number and write to parents; keep a class uniform register.
Personal file is incomplete. Ask the teacher to submit service record, CNIC, academic certificates and training record in one indexed file within 3 days.
Training card not produced. Verify the teacher’s latest training entry with the DEO office and get the card updated.
Class file is below standard. Rebuild the index: attendance register, result sheets, parent contact list, and co-curricular record must all be present.
Assembly photograph not submitted. Class incharges must send the assembly line photo to the school WhatsApp group before 8:15 am.
No extra activity recorded. Schedule one 20-minute activity per week — speech, quiz, calligraphy or plantation drive — and photograph it.

Scoring options: 0 features = 0; 1 feature = 1; 2 features = 2; 3 features = 3; 4 features = 4; 5 features = 5
Remedial action: Classroom features are thin. Target the five printed features — display board, seating plan, cleanliness, lighting and learning corner — add one per week.

Scoring options: None availing = 0; 1–5 students = 1; 6–10 students = 2; 11 or more = 3
Remedial action: Very few students on the transport route. Publicise the bus route and stops at the next parent meeting.

Scoring options: Two or more leaves = 0; One leave = 1; No leave = 2
Remedial action: Leave is above the permitted level. Discuss the pattern, confirm whether leave was sanctioned, and arrange a substitute period plan.

Scoring options: Not in dress = 0; Partly = 1; Full dress code = 2
Remedial action: Dress code not followed on the day checked. Remind the teacher of the notification on prescribed dress for teaching staff.
Monthly donation collection is low. Check whether the class fund register is being issued receipts, and follow up with the parents’ council.
Weekly lesson plan missing. Enforce Monday submission for the coming week, signed by the class incharge and countersigned by the office.

Scoring options: 0 scouts = 0; 5 scouts = 2; 10 scouts = 4; 15 scouts = 6; 20 scouts = 8; 25 scouts = 10
Remedial action: Scout contingent is short. Nominate students at the next assembly and draw uniform from the store.
No social media activity for the week. Send two photographs and a short write-up of class work to the school media focal person.
